changes: The beta extension API: a client part in a Web Worker that sends component trees, an optional Wasm service part in the Host, per-extension credentials, the extension bus, declarative settings (optionally placed in a core Settings section), row context menus, starred and threaded messages. Replaces every alpha API, which is gone.
Mail lists reach every folder and older mail: `/messages/refresh` and `/messages/cache` take any folder id from `/folders` as `folder`, and `/messages/refresh` takes `offset` to load an older page.
The `list` component takes `more` and sends `end` near its end, so a list can load older rows.
